extracted.intended_audience: early-career researchers at universities and DOE national laboratories seeking DOE Office of Science funding
extracted.subtask_description: Summary of the DOE Office of Science Early Career Research Program: who it funds, which research areas are supported, and that it is an annual funding opportunity for individual early-career research programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program purpose / scope
rubrics_metrics.description: The DOE Office of Science Early Career Research Program provides an annual funding opportunity for researchers in universities and DOE national laboratories. It supports the individual research programs of outstanding scientists early in their careers and stimulates research careers in the disciplines supported by the DOE Office of Science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program is intended to fund individual early-career research programs (as opposed to large center grants); established in 2010 and run annually.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible applicant affiliations
rubrics_metrics.description: Researchers in universities and DOE national laboratories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants are expected to be affiliated with either a university or a DOE national laboratory (the page explicitly references these affiliation types as the target applicant pool).

rubrics_metrics.name: Supported disciplines
rubrics_metrics.description: Disciplines supported: Advanced Scientific Computing Research (ASCR), Biological and Environmental Research (BER), Basic Energy Sciences (BES), Fusion Energy Sciences (FES), High Energy Physics (HEP), Isotope R&D and Production (IP), and Nuclear Physics (NP).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should fall within one of these Office of Science program areas to be relevant to this funding opportunity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding frequency and history
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual funding opportunity; program established in 2010.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Competition is run yearly; applicants should plan for an annual cycle and may consult the program page for current solicitation timing and deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal focus (individual research programs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Supports the individual research programs of outstanding scientists early in their careers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis is on the applicant's own independent research program and career development rather than large multi-PI projects or institutional initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Further information / referral
rubrics_metrics.description: You can find more information on the Early Career Research Program page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This listing is a summary; applicants should consult the main Early Career Research Program page for full eligibility rules, solicitation details, application instructions, and review criteria.
